messages:
maria: Quick ask — I'm landing an attn-stitch kernel change in branch `feat/attn-stitch-impl` that merges the KV-cache path with a paged prefix scan. Need a quick smoke + detailed profile run to guard vs perf regressions before canary.

maria: TL;DR: can someone run the microbench harness (long-seq + small-batch mixes) and capture NVTX, flamegraph, and the op-level token timing. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/compare/feat/attn-stitch-impl

devon: I can run. What exact configs? batch sizes, seq len, model(s)?

maria: Thanks. Target models: `rwd-7b-v2` and `rwd-13b-quant`. Please test seq=2048 and 4096, batch=1/4/8 (where memory fits). Also do a cold-start trace (fresh process) + steady state (10 iters warm).

li: I'll do A100-40GB and p4d-8 runs. Want the same harness flags as last week: `--kv-pg=pagecache --profile=nvtx,flame` and the experiment replay at `bench/scripts/attn_stitch.yml`.

sam: If you're collecting op timings, pls add the `op-name` histogram in the harness (I can patch if needed). Also we should compare against `baseline/attn-merge-2026-02-18` run for regression deltas.

jun: Add me on the NVTX traces — I'll look at 95th/99th percentile tail. If there's a tail regression we may want to gate the canary. :eyes:

maria: Yes — if 95p latency > baseline 95p by >10% mark as fail. Also capture peak GPU util and mem footprint.

devon: Repro command I'm using:
```
./bench/harness --model rwd-7b-v2 --seq 2048 --batch 4 --flags "--kv-mode=stitch --profile=nvtx,flame --output=artifacts/2112345678"
```

devon: scheduling now on pool `perf-a100-2` — ETA ~25m.

bench-bot: Run queued: id=run-2112345678-01, pool=perf-a100-2, owner=devon. Estimated duration 18m. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: Artifacts will be uploaded to gs://redwood-perf/artifacts/run-2112345678-01 once complete. I will post links.

li: Heads-up — p4d job may OOM at seq=4096, batch=8 on quant model; I'll try batch 4 there.

sam: Small follow-up: can we also enable the `kv-lifetime` debug counter? It helped find a weird copy earlier.

maria: Yes, please. Add `--debug-counters=kv-lifetime,kv-allocs` to runs.

devon: Run finished. Uploading logs.

bench-bot: Run completed: id=run-2112345678-01 status=SUCCESS. Artifacts: gs://redwood-perf/artifacts/run-2112345678-01/{nvtx.json,flame.svg,op-timings.csv,summary.json}

devon: Quick notes from summary.json: p95 increased by ~6% for rwd-7b-v2 seq=2048 batch=4. p99 unchanged. GPU util +2%. No OOM.

jun: I'll pull the NVTX and flame. If p99 is flat but p95 bumped, likely more small op overheads. I'll check kernel launch patterns.

li: p4d run started for rwd-13b-quant seq=4096 batch=4. Will post if OOM or regress.

sam: I opened a tiny patch to add `op-name` histogram here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/942 — please review quickly, it's just wiring.

maria: Thx. If we see >10% regression we block the canary and revert the default stitch path — I pushed a fast rollback in the rollout plan: `rollouts/attn-stitch-rollback.md`.

devon: One more datapoint: heap snapshots show slightly higher transient GPU allocation at peak token step for the stitch path. Saving heap traces to artifacts.

li: p4d run completed: rwd-13b-quant seq=4096 batch=4 — slight perf delta p95 +12%, p99 +5%, reported in artifacts run-2112345678-02.

bench-bot: Run completed: id=run-2112345678-02 status=SUCCESS. Artifacts: gs://redwood-perf/artifacts/run-2112345678-02/

jun: Seeing compaction-related spikes at token ~1200 in NVTX for the stitch kernel on 13b quant. Looks like an extra memcpy step when pagecache misses. I'll draft a microfix to squash the memcpy.

sam: If it's a memcpy we can try async-copy or fuse the copy into the kernel. I can prototype an inline copy+compute patch.

maria: Great. Next steps: 1) Jun + Sam experiment with async-copy/fuse, 2) Li re-run p4d after microfix, 3) Devon run extended 100-iter steady-state to verify tails. If any p95 > baseline+10% we stop canary.

devon: Acknowledged. I'll queue 100-iter run tomorrow morning on `perf-a100-6`.

maria: Thanks everyone. Leaving the run ids in the rollout doc. Ping me @maria if you need quick access to PR/rollout controls. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: Noted. Follow-up reminders scheduled for 12 hours.

ci-bot: Collected artifacts summary: run-2112345678-01 (7b), run-2112345678-02 (13b-quant). Links in thread above.

jun: I'll post a short writeup of the NVTX findings and attach before/after flamegraphs in ~2 hours.

sam: I'll put up PR for fused-copy prototype later today.

li: re-run queued after microfix: run-2112345678-03.

devon: Thanks team — good coordination. Closing this thread after writeups.
